scope: Three region-specific architectural walkway atlases; four shallow manmade stone/timber cornices each, replacing cave-like ledges in Echo Haven, Cinder Hearth and Starfall Citadel. The connected Haven outer housing quarter uses the same architectural family; its natural base floor and timber link remain regional materials.
source_preservation: Original generated PNGs retained bit-for-bit. Read-only alpha registration, runtime atlas regions, uniform scale and 1024px mipmapped imports; no pixel rewriting, no copied Hollow Knight assets.

No ground underneath, no perspective, no scene, no characters, no text, no UI, no watermarks. Genuine alpha transparency in all empty space.
